Contact Concierge Test Drive Contact Concierge Test Drive 495 Max avail. horsepower 2.9 seconds Avail. 0 to 60 mph time 194 mph* Top track speed 1.02 g Max lateral G-force Make every day epicA dream becomes realityThe performance you want and functionality you need. Stingray offers the perfect combination of performance driving, sculpted design and cargo capacity. DesignStingray offers the ultimate blend of striking design, premium materials, and surprising versatility. Step into luxuryThis cockpit combines advanced technology with expert craftsmanship – all wrapped in genuine leather.Architecture The eighth-generation Corvette’s mid-engine design improves performance in every respect: traction, balance, agility, power delivery, and forward visibility — all boosted by the included Z51 Performance Package. The center of it all Mid-engine architecture enhances traction, forward visibility, handling, and balance. All eyes on you Newly redesigned, the Z51 spoiler turns heads while you turn corners. Wheels and Seats Wheels and seatsWith eye-catching leather seat designs to choose from and a variety of wheel options, there are even more ways to customize your Stingray. Jett BlackThe Jett Black seat features carbon-fiber trim with a seatback halo and is wrapped in genuine Napa leather. Jett Black and Adrenaline RedThe Jett Black and Adrenaline Read seat features carbon-fiber trim with a seatback halo and is wrapped in genuine Napa leather. 5-Open-Spoke Bright Silver-painted aluminium19-inch front and 20-inch rear 5-split-spoke Bright Silver-painted aluminium wheels. 20-Spoke bright machined-face forged-aluminium wheels19-inch front and 20-inch rear 20-spoke bright machined-face forged-aluminium wheels. 5-Split-Spoke Satin Graphite with machined-edge forged-aluminium wheels19-inch front and 20-inch rear 5-split-spoke Satin Graphite machined-edge forged-aluminium wheels. Colors that captivateMetallic, non-metallic, and tintcoat paint finishes provide Stingray with striking visual appeal and stylish features. Arctic White Black Rapid Blue Torch Red Hysteria Metallic Riptide Blue Metallic Sea Wolf Tri Metallic Yellowjacket Tint Metallic High Voltage Tintcoat Red Mist Metallic Tintcoat Contact Concierge Test Drive More Photos (23) Performance Stingray features a naturally aspirated V8 that’s positioned behind the driver, putting more power to the rear wheels where it matters most. With a quarter-mile time of just 11.2 seconds* and an available 495 horsepower, Stingray gives any driver the pulse-pounding ride they crave. 8-speed Dual-clutch transmission 470 lb.-ft. of torque Available Magnetic Selective Ride Control™ 4.0 Available Shifting and Damping Lightning-quick shiftingThe standard 8-speed dual-clutch transmission combines the smoothness of an automatic with the control of a manual, giving you quicker times – lap after lap. Next-generation dampingAvailable Magnetic Selective Ride Control™ 4.0 features an innovative suspension fluid containing metal particles that align to change fluid viscosity, giving you the confidence and control to push harder while staying planted. 3LT CoupePrice on Application*Exterior color, wheels, and interior finish optionsCustom leather-wrapped instrument panel and doorsSueded microfiber upper interior trimStandard GT2 seats with Napa leather seating surfaces View Brochures Contact Concierge Select one or more areas of interest.
